en: Dependent on a state that is non-root, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-root, visible, and impinging by way of root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is non-root, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is non-root, visible, and impinging by way of root condition … one. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are three.
(There are also three [conditions] in the case of the root that is not-a-root, non-indicative, and impinging.

Dependent on a state that is not-a-root, non-indicative, and non-impinging, there arises a state that is not-a-root, non-indicative, and non-impinging by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there is one;
under predominance-condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there is one.
